title: Pitwall message envelope
description: Every message on the bus uses this envelope. The event-specific payload lives under `data` and is validated against its own schema based on `type` + `schemaVersion`. All JSON field names are camelCase; all UUIDs are lowercase canonical (readers normalize-then-validate); all timestamps are RFC3339 UTC with exactly 3-digit milliseconds and a literal `Z`. See contract/README.md (Wire Contract Rules).

id.description: Unique per message; the idempotent inbox dedupe key. Lowercase canonical UUID; UUID v7 RECOMMENDED (time-ordered for cheap inbox indexes + replay ordering).

type.description: <entity>.<action>, matches the routing key, e.g. 'lap.recorded'. Facts are past-tense; intents end '.requested'.

schemaVersion.description: Payload schema version. Bumped only on a BREAKING change to the data payload; additive changes do not bump it (tolerant reader).

envelopeVersion.description: Version of the envelope itself (distinct from the payload's schemaVersion), so the envelope shape can evolve independently. v1 today.

occurredAt.description: When the fact happened. RFC3339 UTC, exactly 3-digit milliseconds, literal 'Z' (never '+00:00').

correlationId.description: Created once at the start of a flow and copied verbatim onto every downstream event (and every log line). Lowercase canonical UUID.

causationId.description: Id of the message that directly caused this one. Null for flow-originating events. Lowercase canonical UUID when present.

data.description: Event-specific payload; validated against the schema for `type` + `schemaVersion`.
